label: XGS-PON OLT class E2, 16 ports
notes: ITU-T G.9807.1 Table B.9.3 (9.95328 Gbit/s downstream): OLT mean launched power +8.0..+11.0 dBm for class E2, ONU sensitivity -28.0 dBm. Upstream OLT receiver per Table B.9.4: -32.0 dBm sensitivity, -11.0 dBm overload. Table B.9.3 prints one E2 column. The +8..+12 dBm column with a +14.5..+16.5 dBm partner is XG-PON's E2a/E2b pair (G.987.2 Amd. 1, Table 9-3), where the hotter column buys the -21.5 dBm ONU a 35 dB class; this recommendation has neither a second E2 column nor a reduced-sensitivity ONU, so this row is all of XGS-PON class E2. The E2 receiver is published rather than FFS: Amd. 1 (05/2025) fills Table B.9.4's E2 column at -32.0 dBm sensitivity and -11.0 dBm overload, which is what this row carries. Corrected 2026-11-27: the note used to call this row G.987.2's E2a variant. Class E2 assumes 20-35 dB of ODN loss (Table B.9.2), so an 8 dBm launch into a short test span arrives above the ONT overload point: attenuate, do not add reach. Replace with the OLT's own datasheet for the line card actually purchased before construction.
